citations.heading: Nassoshi da kwanakin wata
citations.body: Kowane bayani yana haɗe da majiyar da ya fito, da ainihin rubutun, inda yake a cikin majiyar, da kuma ranar da aka duba shi ta ƙarshe. Idan majiya ta kasa buɗewa, ana kiyaye rubutun da aka ajiye domin ka ga abin da aka dogara da shi.

ai.heading: Abubuwan da na'urori masu aiki da kansu suke yi da waɗanda ba sa yi
ai.body: Na'urori masu aiki da kansu za su iya bincika majiyoyi da amsa tambayoyi ta amfani da rubutun da aka amince da su kawai. Ba za su iya tabbatar da wata magana ba, yanke shawarar wanda ke da laifi, canza matsayi, ko wallafa kowane abu. Amsoshinsu bayani ne kawai, ba majiya ba, kuma koyaushe suna nuna majiyoyin da suka yi amfani da su. Idan majiyoyin ba su amsa tambaya ba, amsar za ta bayyana hakan.

scout.heading: Sababbin majiyoyin da aka gano
scout.body: Majiyoyin da aka samu ta hanyar bincike ana sanya musu alamar "an gano — ba a duba ba tukuna". Ba sa cikin kundin bayanan. Mutum ne zai yanke shawarar ko za a ƙara ɗaya, kuma ƙara majiya ba ta sa wata magana zama gaskiya kai tsaye.

review.heading: Duba na ɗan adam
review.body: Mutum ne ke duba shaida kafin ta canza kundin jama'a, kuma wallafawa wani mataki ne na daban daga duba rahoto. Na'urori masu aiki da kansu ba sa wallafawa.

reporting.heading: Bayar da rahoton wata damuwa
reporting.body: Zaka iya aiko da rahoto ba tare da asusu ba, adireshin imel, ko lambar waya. Rahotanni na sirri ne kuma ba a taɓa wallafa su kai tsaye ba. Mai dubawa kawai zai iya karanta su. Ana goge bayanai na ɓoye irin su wurin da aka ɗauki hoto kafin a adana fayiloli da hotuna, kuma zaka iya zaɓar ko zaka ba da bayanan sadarwa.
reporting.limit: Wannan samfurin gwaji ne. Ba sabis na gaggawa ba ne, ba zai iya yin alkawarin ba da amsa ko bayar da kariya ba, kuma bai kamata a yi amfani da shi don ba da rahoton haɗari ba. Idan wani yana cikin haɗari, a fara tuntuɓar ma'aikatan agajin gaggawa na yankin.

correct.heading: Idan wani abu ya yi kama da kuskure
correct.body: Idan kana tunanin wani kundi kuskure ne, ya wuce lokaci, ko babu majiya, za ka iya bayar da rahoto a ɓoye daga wannan kundin. Mai dubawa zai yanke shawarar abin da zai canza, idan da akwai. ShaidaGo ba za ta iya yin alkawarin wani takamaiman sakamako ko lokaci ba.

publication.intro: Sabuntawar jama'a kai ne ka ke rubuta ta, daban da kowane canjin matsayi ko bayanin sirri. Ana nuna ta a kan tsarin lokacin (timeline) jama'a na aikin ne kawai bayan ka duba siffar ta kuma ka tabbatar da ainihin wannan rubutun.
publication.guidance: Fadi kawai abin da majiyoyin da aka ambata suka ce. Kada a kwafi rubutu daga rahoton sirri, kuma kada ka kira kowa ko wani abu hanci-da-rashawa (corrupt), yaudara (fraudulent), mai laifi (guilty), watsi (abandoned), ko kammalaffe (complete) sai idan wata majiya da aka ambata ta ce haka a cikin waɗannan kalmomin.
publication.needsVerified: Ana iya rubuta daftarin sabuntawar jama'a ne kawai idan an sanya wa rahoton alamar An tabbatar don sabuntawar jama'a. Canza matsayin tukunna.
publication.noCitations: Babu wasu nassoshi da aka amince dasu da ake da su don wannan aikin, don haka ba za a iya rubuta daftarin sabuntawar jama'a ba.
publication.citationsUnavailable: Ba a iya loda nassoshin da aka amince da su na wannan aikin ba, don haka ba za a iya tsara daftarin sabuntawar jama'a yanzu ba. Sake loda shafin don sake gwadawa.
publication.statementHint: Rubutu ne kawai, haruffa 10 zuwa {max}. Kalmomi masu tsaka-tsaki kawai (neutral wording). Kowa yana ganinsa.

codes.analysis_invalid: Ba a iya duba binciken akan majiyoyin ba, don haka ba a nuna shi ba.

codes.rate_limited: Buƙatun sun yi yawa. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
codes.dead_letter: Aikin yaci gaba da gaza kuma an tsayar da shi. Mai dubawa zai iya fara sabon bincike.

failure.generic: Binciken ya ƙare ba tare da sakamakon da za a iya amfani dashi ba.
failure.partial: Majiyoyin da aka samo kafin ya tsaya ana nuna su a ƙasa kuma wataƙila ba su kammala ba.
failure.empty: Babu abin da aka gano kafin ya tsaya.

states.stale: Waɗannan sakamakon ƙila sun tsufa. Aikin ya ƙare a {date}.

controls.cancelBody: Aikin da ya rage za'a tsayar. Duk abin da aka riga aka gano za a ajiye.
controls.keep: Ci gaba da gudanar da shi
controls.cancelRequested: An buƙaci sokewa. Aikin da aka riga aka yi an kiyaye shi.
controls.reviewTitle: Yi rikodin wannan shawarar akan aikin?
controls.approveBody: Wannan yana tabbatar da cewa aikin ya gama da kyau. Ba ya tabbatar da kowace majiya ko wallafa komai.
controls.rejectBody: Wannan yana ƙin aikin. Majiyoyin sa zasu ci gaba da kasancewa ba a duba su ba.

followUps.heading: Tambayoyi na gaba (Follow-up)
followUps.answerHint: Ana kiyaye shi a ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya (memory) har sai ka aika dashi. Ba a taɓa sanyawa a cikin adireshin (address) ko ajiyewa a cikin wannan masarrafar (browser) ba.
followUps.unsafe: Yi alamar cewa bai dace a yi tambaya ba (unsafe to ask)
followUps.sent: An yi rikodin. Abin da ka rubuta ba za a sake nuna shi ba.
followUps.flagged: An yi alamar bashi da tsaro.
followUps.tooLong: Wannan amsar ta yi tsayi da yawa.
followUps.stale: Wannan tambayar ta wani aiki daban ne, don haka ba a aika da ita ba.

decisions.attach: Maƙalawa azaman majiyar da ke jiran aiki (pending source)
decisions.reasonHint: Ka ce dalili. Har zuwa haruffa 400. Ana ajiyewa a asirce.
decisions.reasonTooLong: Wannan dalilin yayi tsayi da yawa.
decisions.confirmTitle: Yi rikodin wannan shawara akan majiyar?
decisions.attachBody: Wannan zai ƙirƙiri majiyar jiran aiki don majiyar da aka amince da ita (approved-source workflow). Ba ya amincewa da wata gaskiya ko wallafa komai.
decisions.rejectBody: Wannan yana ƙin amincewa da majiyar don wannan rahoton. Zata kasance an jera ta kuma ana iya sake duba ta.
decisions.deferBody: Wannan yana ajiye majiyar ba tare da yanke shawara ta ƙarshe ba.
decisions.reconsiderBody: Wannan yana mayar da majiyar baya zuwa ga jinkirtawa.
decisions.conflict: Wannan majiyar ta canza tun bayan da ka loda ta, ko kuma wannan shawarar ba ta samuwa yanzu. Sake loda sakamakon kuma sake gwadawa.

dispositions.attached: An maƙala azaman majiyar dake jiran aiki (ba a tabbatar ba)

offline.title: Ba ka kan layi
offline.lead: ShaidaGo ba za ta iya samun intanet ba. Shafukan da ka buɗe kwanan nan ƙila an ajiye su akan wannan na'urar.
offline.savedNone: Ba a ajiye wasu shafuka tukuna ba. Buɗe kundin aikin yayin da kake kan layi kuma za'a kiyaye shi anan har sati ɗaya.
offline.savedNote: Shafin da aka ajiye yana nuna ranar da aka duba ta ƙarshe da yake da shi lokacin da aka ajiye shi. Wataƙila ya wuce lokaci.
offline.cleared: An cire shafukan da aka ajiye daga wannan na'urar.
offline.privateNote: Rahotanni, bibiya, da ayyukan mai dubawa suna buƙatar intanet (connection). Babu abin da ka shigar da aka aika, aka adana, ko aka sa a layi yayin da kake wajen layi (offline).
offline.banner: Ba ka kan layi. Wannan shafin kwafi ne da aka ajiye daga {date} kuma ƙila ya wuce lokaci.
offline.bannerNoDate: Ba ka kan layi. Kuna ganin kwafin da aka ajiye wanda ƙila ya wuce lokaci.
offline.updateApply: Sake loda don amfani da shi
offline.updateLater: Zai yi aiki a gaba idan ka buɗe ShaidaGo. Bai shafi rahotonka ba.
